svg.title: Krishna Anubhav: finance, engineering and quantitative systems
svg.desc: Animated profile banner for Krishna Anubhav (Kavy). Engineer, then SaaS founder and operator, then MBA, now investment banking. I spent years building businesses; now I am learning how investors value them. The rising line and bars on the right are decorative and carry no data. The ticker along the bottom reads: 15 PULL REQUESTS MERGED INTO OTHER PROJECTS • 41 OPENED IN TOTAL • 6 ORIGINAL PUBLIC REPOS • MERGED INTO QUANTLIB, EDGARTOOLS, EVER-GAUZY, RISKFOLIO-LIB, TRADE-FRAME, FINANCEPY, FINANCETOOLKIT, STOCKSTATS • LANGUAGES PYTHON 41% · RUST 36% · C++ 9% · JAVASCRIPT 7%
